summary: Upstream-OQ gate: whether a body mention of an RFC keeps counting as a dependency

options.description: Body mentions keep refusing; revisit one week after AISDLC-1320 lands
Only declared dependencies refuse; a body mention prints a warning (loosens the gate)
Only declared dependencies count; prose is never read (loosens the gate)

body: Problem: the upstream-OQ gate refuses a task whose body names an RFC with open questions unless frontmatter assumes: lists it, which costs a refused filing when the RFC is only the subject. AISDLC-1320 fixes the false counts and makes the refusal name assumes:. Ruling: body mentions keep counting; the planner counts refusals one week after AISDLC-1320 lands and brings the question back if false refusals continue. The options are those put to the operator through the decision rubric on 2026-11-18; recorded by the planner.
